'''catman421 PPD 11: There Is Good In Him (TIGIH)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 7 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''Strategy:''' There Is Good In Him
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 TIGIH catman421 LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

The 11th Player's Preconstruct Deck.  Enjoy!

The published list has 63 cards.
